notes: Snapshot only, not a historical time series.
Raw source values and status codes are preserved; no alert thresholds recalculated.
Water levels are relative to mean sea level, not street flood depth.
Blank or null is not zero. Source thresholds require validation before reuse, especially across water_system_id.
Source timestamps are shown unchanged and interpreted as Thai local time.
Flood status is distinct from sensor status and observation freshness.
